node_definition.done_when: The generic refresh generalises the checks refresh in reckon/serve.py and reckon/compliance.py: at most one child per key, and a parent waiter thread per running child. A test forces a cold recompute of discovery, of the checks summary and of the fleet rollup for a temporary project, each route's computation stubbed with a delay of at least 200 ms; while it runs the route itself answers in under 50 ms from the prior result with an age header, and when it finishes the route answers with the recompute's own result, identified by a marker the stub writes. Each case's negative control computes the route inline under the same delay, and the 50 ms bound fails. Handler._send_project_changes reads the stored discovery and spawns only on a miss; _FleetChangeWatch (reckon/change_streams.py) alone spawns on a change. A fleet-rollup case changes two projects at once and asserts one rollup child runs; its negative control keys the rollup per project, and two children run. A fleet-event case runs the refresh in a child process, changes the stored rollup, and asserts that a stream open on a temporary project receives one fleet event naming the rollup's key, through the parent's waiter; its negative control publishes only per-project events, and the assertion fails. docs/ui/state-loader.js dispatches each fleet event on window as a reckon-fleet event carrying the key, beside its existing onChange call. Velocity and the velocity pane are a later node on this section and are not changed here. Tests that encode the old inline computation (tests/test_document_compliance.py, tests/test_spa_document_checks.py, tests/test_rollup_isolates_a_project.py, tests/test_shell_project_list_is_immediate.py, tests/test_changes_push_rows.py, tests/test_cross_node_writes_refresh_the_index.py) are updated to the new contract without deleting or loosening any case. Tests importing reckon/serve.py, reckon/change_streams.py or reckon/compliance.py and the SPA test files show no added failure against base (the coordinator runs the full population at merge, and the srv-1006 live measure after deploy). Every log sits under the run directory and ends in EXIT=, suites run on the fleet allocation and not the login node, and ruff check and ruff format --check add no findings on the changed Python files.
node_definition.goal: Serve discovery, the checks summary and the fleet rollup from stored results that one generic child-process refresh keeps current, publishing each fleet-scoped result as a fleet event on every open change stream
